statement.name: get
statement.sql:
select * from (select distinct cast(fai.activity_instance_id as varchar(36)) as id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER
(order by fai.activity_instance_id) AS RowNumber,
() AS RowNumber,
count(*) over() as QueryCount1, cast(fai.activity_definition_id as varchar(36)) as activityDefinitionID, cast(fai.process_instance_id as varchar(36)) as processInstanceID, fai.current_state_id as state, fai.container_xml as containerXML, fai.client_status_msg as clientStatusMsg, fai.priority as priority, fai.automated_class_name as automatedClass, fai.activity_desc as description, fai.finish_mode_id as finishModeID, fai.activity_implementation_id as implementationID, fai.loop_condition as loopCondition, fai.client_status_msg_xml as clientStatusMsgXml, fai.required_work_item_count as requiredWorkItemCount, fai.start_mode_id as startModeID, cast(fai.sub_process_definition_id as varchar(36)) as subProcessDefID, cast(fai.sub_process_instance_id as varchar(36)) as subProcessInstID, fai.transition_restriction_id as transitionRestrictionID, fai.work_item_limit as workItemLimit, fai.update_datetime as lastUpdateDate, fai.create_datetime as createdDate, case when fai.activity_implementation_id in (2, 3) and fai.start_mode_id = 2 and fai.current_state_id = 4 and (fai.work_item_limit is null or fai.work_item_limit > (select count(cast(work_item_id as varchar(36))) workItemCount from fact_work_item fwi2 WITH (NOLOCK) where fai.activity_instance_id = fwi2.activity_instance_id and fwi2.latest_flag = 1)) then 1 else 0 end pullable
,(select case when min(faiAll.activity_desc) is null and ((fpir.process_instance_id is null and fpi.current_state_id in (6, 7, 8)) or (fpir.process_instance_id is not null and fpir.current_state_id in (6, 7, 8))) then 'Closed' when min(faiAll.activity_desc) is null and ((fpir.process_instance_id is null and fpi.current_state_id in (4, 5)) or (fpir.process_instance_id is not null and fpir.current_state_id in (4, 5))) then 'Stand By' else min(faiAll.activity_desc) end from FACT_PROCESS_INSTANCE fpiAll WITH (NOLOCK) left outer join FACT_ACTIVITY_INSTANCE faiAll WITH (NOLOCK) on faiAll.process_instance_id = fpiAll.process_instance_id and faiAll.current_state_id = 4 and faiAll.activity_implementation_id in (2, 3) where fpiAll.root_process_instance_id = fpi.process_instance_id or fpiAll.root_process_instance_id = fpi.root_process_instance_id or fpiAll.process_instance_id = fpi.process_instance_id) status
, dtl.*
,isnull(lts.lookupcode,0) taskStatusLookupCode , isnull(lts.displayvalue,'N/A') taskStatusDisplayValue
from FACT_ACTIVITY_INSTANCE fai WITH (NOLOCK)
inner join FACT_PROCESS_INSTANCE fpi WITH (NOLOCK) on fai.process_instance_id = fpi.process_instance_id
left outer join FACT_ACTIVITY_INSTANCE fai2 WITH (NOLOCK) on fai.process_instance_id = fai2.sub_process_instance_id inner join PROCESS_INSTANCE_CONTEXT pic WITH (NOLOCK) on fai2.process_instance_id = pic.process_instance_id
inner join #tmpDetails dtl WITH (NOLOCK) on pic.object_id = dtl.object_id and pic.object_type_id = dtl.object_type_id
left outer join FACT_TRANSITION_RUNTIME ftr WITH (NOLOCK) on fai.activity_instance_id = ftr.to_activity_instance_id and ((fai.activity_implementation_id in (5, 6) and ftr.transition_type_id <> 2) or fai.activity_implementation_id in (1, 2, 3, 4))
left outer join gems.dbo.tasks t WITH (NOLOCK) on fai.Activity_Instance_Id = t.ClientTaskId left outer join gems.dbo.lookuptaskstatus lts WITH (NOLOCK) on t.taskstatuscode = lts.lookupcode
null
(2, 3) 2
4
null (select count(cast(fwi.work_item_id as varchar(36))) from FACT_WORK_ITEM fwi WITH (NOLOCK) where fai.activity_instance_id = fwi.activity_instance_id and fwi.latest_flag = 1)
(select count(cast(fwi.work_item_id as varchar(36))) from FACT_WORK_ITEM fwi WITH (NOLOCK) where fai.activity_instance_id = fwi.activity_instance_id and fwi.latest_flag = 1)
(2, 3) 2 4
null (select count(cast(fwi.work_item_id as varchar(36))) from FACT_WORK_ITEM fwi WITH (NOLOCK) where fai.activity_instance_id = fwi.activity_instance_id and fwi.latest_flag = 1)
(2, 3) 2 (select count(cast(fwi.work_item_id as varchar(36))) from FACT_WORK_ITEM fwi WITH (NOLOCK) where fai.activity_instance_id = fwi.activity_instance_id and fwi.latest_flag = 1)
UNION select distinct cast(fai.activity_instance_id as varchar(36)) as id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER
(order by fai.activity_instance_id) AS RowNumber,
() AS RowNumber,
count(*) over() as QueryCount1, cast(fai.activity_definition_id as varchar(36)) as activityDefinitionID, cast(fai.process_instance_id as varchar(36)) as processInstanceID, fai.current_state_id as state, fai.container_xml as containerXML, fai.client_status_msg as clientStatusMsg, fai.priority as priority, fai.automated_class_name as automatedClass, fai.activity_desc as description, fai.finish_mode_id as finishModeID, fai.activity_implementation_id as implementationID, fai.loop_condition as loopCondition, fai.client_status_msg_xml as clientStatusMsgXml, fai.required_work_item_count as requiredWorkItemCount, fai.start_mode_id as startModeID, cast(fai.sub_process_definition_id as varchar(36)) as subProcessDefID, cast(fai.sub_process_instance_id as varchar(36)) as subProcessInstID, fai.transition_restriction_id as transitionRestrictionID, fai.work_item_limit as workItemLimit, fai.update_datetime as lastUpdateDate, fai.create_datetime as createdDate, case when fai.activity_implementation_id in (2, 3) and fai.start_mode_id = 2 and fai.current_state_id = 4 and (fai.work_item_limit is null or fai.work_item_limit > (select count(cast(work_item_id as varchar(36))) workItemCount from fact_work_item fwi2 WITH (NOLOCK) where fai.activity_instance_id = fwi2.activity_instance_id and fwi2.latest_flag = 1)) then 1 else 0 end pullable
,(select case when min(faiAll.activity_desc) is null and ((fpir.process_instance_id is null and fpi.current_state_id in (6, 7, 8)) or (fpir.process_instance_id is not null and fpir.current_state_id in (6, 7, 8))) then 'Closed' when min(faiAll.activity_desc) is null and ((fpir.process_instance_id is null and fpi.current_state_id in (4, 5)) or (fpir.process_instance_id is not null and fpir.current_state_id in (4, 5))) then 'Stand By' else min(faiAll.activity_desc) end from FACT_PROCESS_INSTANCE fpiAll WITH (NOLOCK) left outer join FACT_ACTIVITY_INSTANCE faiAll WITH (NOLOCK) on faiAll.process_instance_id = fpiAll.process_instance_id and faiAll.current_state_id = 4 and faiAll.activity_implementation_id in (2, 3) where fpiAll.root_process_instance_id = fpi.process_instance_id or fpiAll.root_process_instance_id = fpi.root_process_instance_id or fpiAll.process_instance_id = fpi.process_instance_id) status
, dtl.*
,isnull(lts.lookupcode,0) taskStatusLookupCode , isnull(lts.displayvalue,'N/A') taskStatusDisplayValue
from FACT_ACTIVITY_INSTANCE fai WITH (NOLOCK)
inner join FACT_PROCESS_INSTANCE fpi WITH (NOLOCK) on fai.process_instance_id = fpi.process_instance_id
left outer join FACT_ACTIVITY_INSTANCE fai2 WITH (NOLOCK) on fai.process_instance_id = fai2.sub_process_instance_id inner join PROCESS_INSTANCE_CONTEXT pic WITH (NOLOCK) on fpi.process_instance_id = pic.process_instance_id
inner join #tmpDetails dtl WITH (NOLOCK) on pic.object_id = dtl.object_id and pic.object_type_id = dtl.object_type_id
left outer join FACT_TRANSITION_RUNTIME ftr WITH (NOLOCK) on fai.activity_instance_id = ftr.to_activity_instance_id and ((fai.activity_implementation_id in (5, 6) and ftr.transition_type_id <> 2) or fai.activity_implementation_id in (1, 2, 3, 4))
left outer join gems.dbo.tasks t WITH (NOLOCK) on fai.Activity_Instance_Id = t.ClientTaskId left outer join gems.dbo.lookuptaskstatus lts WITH (NOLOCK) on t.taskstatuscode = lts.lookupcode
null

4
null (select count(cast(fwi.work_item_id as varchar(36))) from FACT_WORK_ITEM fwi WITH (NOLOCK) where fai.activity_instance_id = fwi.activity_instance_id and fwi.latest_flag = 1)
(select count(cast(fwi.work_item_id as varchar(36))) from FACT_WORK_ITEM fwi WITH (NOLOCK) where fai.activity_instance_id = fwi.activity_instance_id and fwi.latest_flag = 1)
(2, 3) 2 4
null (select count(cast(fwi.work_item_id as varchar(36))) from FACT_WORK_ITEM fwi WITH (NOLOCK) where fai.activity_instance_id = fwi.activity_instance_id and fwi.latest_flag = 1)
(2, 3) 2 (select count(cast(fwi.work_item_id as varchar(36))) from FACT_WORK_ITEM fwi WITH (NOLOCK) where fai.activity_instance_id = fwi.activity_instance_id and fwi.latest_flag = 1)
) as dtl
; drop table #tmpDetails

statement.name: getProcessRelatedObjects
statement.sql:
select cast(fai.activity_instance_id as varchar(36)) as activityId, pic.object_type_id as objectTypeId, pic.object_id as objectId from fact_activity_instance fai inner join fact_process_instance fpi on fpi.process_instance_id = fai.process_instance_id left outer join fact_process_instance fpir on fpi.root_process_instance_id = fpir.process_instance_id inner join process_instance_context pic on (fpi.process_instance_id = pic.process_instance_id or fpir.process_instance_id = pic.process_instance_id)
order by fai.activity_instance_id, pic.object_type_id

statement.name: getOutgoingTransitions
statement.sql:
select cast(faiFrom.activity_instance_id as varchar(36)) as activityId, cast(ftr.transition_runtime_id as varchar(36)) as transitionId, ftr.transition_desc as description, ftr.transition_type_id as typeId, cast(ftr.from_activity_instance_id as varchar(36)) as fromId, cast(ftr.to_activity_instance_id as varchar(36)) as toId, ftr.condition as condition from FACT_TRANSITION_RUNTIME ftr inner join FACT_ACTIVITY_INSTANCE faiFrom on ftr.from_activity_instance_id = faiFrom.activity_instance_id
order by faiFrom.activity_instance_id, ftr.transition_desc

statement.name: getRunningActivities
statement.sql:
select distinct cast(fai.activity_instance_id as varchar(36)) as activityId, cast(faiRun.activity_instance_id as varchar(36)) as runActivityId, cast(faiRun.activity_definition_id as varchar(36)) as activityDefinitionID, cast(faiRun.process_instance_id as varchar(36)) as processInstanceID, faiRun.current_state_id as state, faiRun.container_xml as containerXML, faiRun.client_status_msg as clientStatusMsg, faiRun.priority as priority, faiRun.automated_class_name as automatedClass, faiRun.activity_desc as description, faiRun.finish_mode_id as finishModeID, faiRun.activity_implementation_id as implementationID, faiRun.loop_condition as loopCondition, faiRun.client_status_msg_xml as clientStatusMsgXml, faiRun.required_work_item_count as requiredWorkItemCount, faiRun.start_mode_id as startModeID, cast(faiRun.sub_process_definition_id as varchar(36)) as subProcessDefID, cast(faiRun.sub_process_instance_id as varchar(36)) as subProcessInstID, faiRun.transition_restriction_id as transitionRestrictionID, faiRun.work_item_limit as workItemLimit, faiRun.update_datetime as lastUpdateDate, faiRun.create_datetime as createdDate from FACT_ACTIVITY_INSTANCE fai inner join FACT_PROCESS_INSTANCE fpi on fai.process_instance_id = fpi.process_instance_id left outer join FACT_PROCESS_INSTANCE fpir on fpi.root_process_instance_id = fpir.process_instance_id left outer join FACT_PROCESS_INSTANCE fpisub on fpisub.root_process_instance_id = fpir.process_instance_id or fpisub.root_process_instance_id = fpi.process_instance_id inner join FACT_ACTIVITY_INSTANCE faiRun on faiRun.process_instance_id = fpi.process_instance_id or faiRun.process_instance_id = fpir.process_instance_id or faiRun.process_instance_id = fpisub.process_instance_id
4 (2, 3)
order by activityId, faiRun.activity_desc

statement.name: update
statement.sql:
update workflow.dbo.FACT_ACTIVITY_INSTANCE
from workflow.dbo.FACT_ACTIVITY_INSTANCE fai
inner join workflow.dbo.FACT_PROCESS_INSTANCE fpi on fai.process_instance_id = fpi.process_instance_id
